Name: Shads Context Tags Compatibility
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[size=4][b]Short Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You ever got a huge stack of modded items from one mod that you want to use in another mod's machines? Maybe you want to add generalized inputs to your mod but you're not quite sure what context tags to use? You're in luck! This mod is for you[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Detailed Description [/size][/b]
Shads's Context Tags Compatability (aka [b]SCTC[/b]) is a utility mod designed to add universal context tags to other mods' items for the express purpose of easing cross mod compatibility. It's extremely helpful when creating generalized inputs for artisan machines. The context tags are based off of the Cornucopia Family of Mods' context tags. 

SCTC comes with some mods already added to it, with more planned to be added in the future! The goal is to include all major expansion mods, all the major crop mods, and many of the major food and artisan goods mods. It's a big undertaking, and I can't do it alone! If you're interested in contributing to this project, please shoot me a message here on nexus.

Version 1.0 focuses on crops and forage. Eventually there are plans to extend this to artisan goods, fish, and animal products, and perhaps even minerals and artifact types if there's an interest in those.  Documentation for modders with the tag list is coming soon

[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]This mod has so many mods listed...I don't want to install them all [/b]

Great news, you don't! This mod only requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to run. All the other mods are optional dependencies, and really are included only so that way people are aware of what version they need. SCTC only loads the files pertaining to the mods you have installed on your individual save

[b]I want to request a mod to be added, what can I do?[/b]

Leave a comment with a link to the mod and I'll it to the future mods list. Or, if you want to take a crack at programming it yourself, this mod includes a file tags_template.json that you can make a copy of and then alter. Please note that making your own .json file does require some experience. I cannot help with any issues arising from a user's homemade tag files. Do not report bugs caused by homemade tag files. 

[b]There's yellow warnings in my smapi log about this mod. Help![/b]

Nothing to worry about. It probably means that the item was removed or renamed in an updated version of one of the mods this mod interacts with. SMAPI will safely skip over applying those rules. Your game will be fine. Leave a comment about the warning, saying which mod and item it is. If you have trouble interpreting SMAPI, a screenshot or a SMAPI log works too. Please do not open a bug report solely for an unapplied context tag.
